# Maxora Technology

> Maxora Technology is a software development and digital engineering agency serving growing businesses worldwide, as well as companies across the Patiala, Punjab region (including Patiala, Rajpura, Nabha, Samana, Sirhind, Sangrur, Malerkotla, Khanna, Mohali, Zirakpur, Chandigarh, and Ambala). The company builds custom web applications, mobile apps, CRM/ERP systems, e-commerce platforms, and provides technical SEO & AI search optimization.

- Legal Status: Registered MSME Enterprise (Govt. of India)
- Geographic Service Scope: Worldwide, Pan-India, and Regional Punjab (Patiala & surrounding towns)
- Primary Focus: Custom Software Engineering, Next.js/React Web Applications, Mobile App Development (React Native & Flutter), Custom CRM/ERP Systems, E-Commerce Development, WordPress Engineering, and Technical SEO & AI Answer Engine Optimization (AEO/GEO).

## Services & Solutions

- [Services Overview](https://maxoratechnology.com/Services): Comprehensive suite of engineering and software development capabilities.
- [Custom Web Development](https://maxoratechnology.com/Services/web-development): High-performance web applications built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Node.js.
- [Mobile App Development](https://maxoratechnology.com/Services/app-development): Native and cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android using Flutter and React Native.
- [Custom CRM & ERP Systems](https://maxoratechnology.com/Services/crm-erp): Tailored business management systems, workflow automation, and enterprise integrations.
- [E-Commerce Platforms](https://maxoratechnology.com/Services/ecommerce): High-converting online stores built on Shopify, WooCommerce, and headless commerce architectures.
- [WordPress Solutions](https://maxoratechnology.com/Services/wordpress): Bespoke Gutenberg block themes, custom plugin engineering, and site speed optimization.
- [Technical SEO & AEO Services](https://maxoratechnology.com/Services/seo-aeo): Core Web Vitals engineering, Schema.org entity graphs, extractable content answer blocks, and technical foundations for AI engine citation readiness across ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.
- [AI & Automation Services](https://maxoratechnology.com/Services/ai-automation): AI voice assistants, conversational WhatsApp bots (official Meta Cloud API), automated lead qualification, CRM webhook orchestration, and autonomous document extraction agents.
- [Free AI Visibility Check](https://maxoratechnology.com/ai-visibility-check): Free technical audit testing whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews cite and recommend a prospect's business.
- [Portfolio & Case Studies](https://maxoratechnology.com/portfolio): Live software demos and architectural case studies.
